name: Inspect AI
description: Open-source evaluation framework from the UK AI Security Institute. Evals are Python tasks composed of a dataset, solvers (prompting, tool use, multi-turn agents, sandboxes) and scorers (exact match, model-graded, custom), with a log viewer for inspecting every sample. The companion inspect_evals package ships 200+ ready-to-run evals. Results are self-run by whoever executes the task; Inspect is also the engine behind Epoch AI's and lighteval's evaluations, so many published third-party numbers trace back to it.
notes: First PyPI release inspect-ai 0.0.1 on 2024-04-03 (repo created 2023-11). Benchmark list is from the inspect_evals README (UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_evals): mmlu, mmlu_pro, gpqa_diamond, hle, aime2025, humaneval, mbpp, gsm8k, math, hellaswag, bbh, ifeval, simpleqa, mmmu, drop, winogrande, truthfulqa, bfcl, swe_bench (SWE-bench Verified), gaia, osworld, agent_bench_os, tau2, browse_comp, mle_bench, paperbench (marked work in progress).
